_doc: Smoke recipes for tools/release.py. Coordinates are FRACTIONS of the live screen (x/w, y/h) so the same recipe works on any device size. Each recipe must end with shots named gp1 and gp2 taken INSIDE gameplay, with something that moves between them (HUD timer/score or world motion). launch_wait = seconds between monkey launch and the first observation.
